name: My submission history
description: The caller's own versions, private rows included. The session check cannot be a join inside the aggregate as it is on the other authed reads: json_agg with no GROUP BY returns one row whatever it is fed, so a revoked session would have got 200 and an empty list -- a rejection indistinguishable from having submitted nothing. live_sessions is therefore the outer FROM, which yields no row at all when the session is dead, and `deny` tests the `session_ok` marker rather than `body`, because an empty list is falsy.

input.query: SELECT (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.created_at DESC), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT m.id, u.handle AS owner, g.slug AS game, m.version, m.repo, m.release_tag, m.weight_class AS class, m.size_bytes, m.status, model_phase(m) AS phase, m.reject_reason, m.created_at, (SELECT se.number FROM seasons se WHERE se.id = m.season_id) AS season, model_ratings(m.id, ($4)::float8) AS ratings, (SELECT max(mt.played_at) FROM match_seats ms JOIN matches mt ON mt.id = ms.match_id WHERE ms.model_id = m.id) AS last_played_at FROM models m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.owner_id JOIN games g ON g.id = m.game_id WHERE m.owner_id = ($1)::uuid AND (($2)::text IS NULL OR g.slug = ($2)::text)) x) AS body, ls.sid AS session_ok FROM live_sessions ls WHERE ls.sid = ($3)::uuid AND ls.user_id = ($1)::uuid
